publicCompostDataset.limitation: Predicts compost maturity chemistry (Score) from lab sensors, not flower species dry-matter conversion, incense/gulal yield, or INR financial profit.

financialYieldMLSuitability.reason: No public empirical dataset contains paired temple flower species, moisture condition, contamination %, processing method, finished product output (incense/compost/gulal/decor), and actual Indian INR costs/sales across >=100 real batches. Training ML on small rule-generated or synthetic rows would cause circular data leakage and misleading confidence.
financialYieldMLSuitability.futureMLArchitectureReady: FlowerCycle stores every verified batch in MongoDB (CalculationHistory + WasteRecord + FinancialTransaction). Once >=100 real verified processing batches are accumulated, ml/evaluate_dataset.py can be re-run to train scikit-learn yield & cost regressors.
